# f5xc_rate_limiter_policy (Data Source)

Rate limiter policy defines parameters that can be used for fine-grained control over requests for a http load balancer that are subjected to rate limiting.<br><br>It will create the following child objects.<br><br>* service_policy<br>* service_policy_rule

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Rate Limiter Policy - Full

data "f5xc_rate_limiter_policy" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_rate_limiter_policy.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_rate_limiter_policy.example.namespace
}
```
